auth.confirmationSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. It can take a few minutes to arrive — check your spam and Promotions folders if you don't see it. Follow the link to finish creating your account, then come back and log in.
auth.consentBefore: By signing up you agree to our
auth.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
auth.emailTypo: Did you mean {{suggestion}}? Tap to use it.
auth.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a link to reset your password.
auth.resetPasswordIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth.usernameHint: This is the name shown next to your reviews and the places you add. You can change it later.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language LocaStar uses. Following the system means it changes when your phone does.

notifications.deleteAllBody: This can’t be undone. Anything they point to — friend requests, shared lists, places — stays where it is.
notifications.roleGrantedBody1: Thank you for everything you’ve contributed to LocaStar. You can now handle reports, hide or remove content that breaks the rules, and propose bans.
notifications.roleGrantedBody2: With great power comes great responsibility — every action you take is recorded in the moderation log, so use it thoughtfully and fairly.
notifications.friendRequestBody: Tap to accept or decline it on your Friends page.
notifications.friendAcceptedBody: You can now share places and lists with each other.
notifications.reminderBody: You saved this. Tap to see the details.

add.title: Add to the map
add.intro: LocaStar is only as good as what people put in it. If you know somewhere worth going, add it — the next person looking will be glad you did.
add.signedOut: You need an account to add to the map.
add.placeBody: A court, a trail, a gym, a swimming spot — somewhere that is always there.
add.activityBody: A festival, a match, a meet-up — something happening on a date.

profile.title: Profile
profile.loggedOutPrompt: Log in to save favorites, write reviews, and add your own locations.
profile.logOutConfirmBody: You’ll need to log in again to access your account.
profile.banUntil: Until {{date}}, you can browse but not post reviews, add locations, or share.
profile.banIndefinite: You can browse but not post reviews, add locations, or share.

home.ctaTitle: Create an account and do more:

location.deletePhotoBody: It is removed from this place for everyone, and the deletion is recorded in the moderation log. This cannot be undone.
location.makeCoverBody: This picture will lead the gallery and appear on this place wherever it is listed.
location.deleteReviewBody: Your rating and any photos on it go too, and the place’s average is recalculated. This can’t be undone.
location.removeReviewBody: It stops being visible to everyone immediately, and the removal is recorded in the moderation log. It can be restored from there.
location.removeCreatorBody: Your username will no longer show as “Added by” on this listing. This can’t be undone.
location.reportLocationConfirm: Our team will review this location.
location.reportReviewConfirm: Our team will review this review.
location.creatorWindow: You added this — you can edit it for {{time}} more.
location.deleteLocationBody: This permanently deletes “{{name}}” and everything tied to it — reviews, photos, saves, and shares, including anything the people you invited added. This can’t be undone.
